gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at a flat, constant line weight, its rounds left a little open like a cracked bangle. Coming Soon is the loose, pen-and-paper one, best when it wants to sound personal, while Hind Siliguri keeps the sentences tidy.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-hind-vadodara: A round o with walls of constant thickness gives Coming Soon its hand-drawn, casual look, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Hind Vadodara, in sans-serif, stays tall-bowled and open.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-huninn: Coming Soon looks like casual pen-and-paper lettering, with lowercase climbing close to the capitals. Huninn, a sans-serif with fat crossbars and clear s terminals, takes over once the big, short, personal line has done its work.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-inter-tight: Casual and personal, Coming Soon writes its o as a ring with a constant wall, nearly capital-tall in lowercase. Shrink it and Inter Tight wins.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-julius-sans-one: Coming Soon looks scribbled by hand, casual and personal. It earns its keep big and short, while Julius Sans One lays out sans-serif curves with wide gaps between letters and almost no step from capitals down to lowercase.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-kadwa: Casual and personal, Coming Soon draws tubular, wire-like letters that look jotted down by hand. Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, gives the page its editorial footing.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-karla: Coming Soon feels like tracing a single thick thread. It handles the casual, personal voice well, while Karla's gaping openings and stocky, tall middle band do the steady everyday work of a sans.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-kedebideri: Coming Soon hums along in a flat gray line of constant weight, casual and handwritten. Kedebideri's sans letters, with a skyward x-height and rounded open forms, are the ones to enlarge if the text needs more room.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-khula: Khula reads as a plain sans with a tall midsection, like a squat brush-pen belly, and curves that hold their mouths open. Next to it, Coming Soon feels like a fixed-width nib scribbling a note beside typeset text.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-krub: Krub stands tall with a pronounced x-height and curves that stop short. Coming Soon is best at casual, personal handwriting with arches matching its stems, while Krub is best at keeping the sans text contemporary and tidy.
